title: clinopodium javanicum
intro: Clinopodium javanicum, commonly known as Javan ginger or Javan basil, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The health benefits of Clinopodium javanicum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and relieve pain. Bioactive constituents of Clinopodium javanicum include essential oils such as limonene, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
